prompt: What is the name of the Australian novelist who is one of only five writers to have won the Booker Prize twice and also won the Jerusalem Prize?
answer: The novelist is **J. M. Coetzee (John Maxwell Coetzee)**, the South African-born Australian author who won the Booker Prize twice and the Jerusalem Prize.
